title.value: AN ACT CONCERNING THE USE OF PFAS IN CERTAIN PRODUCTS
title.provenance: AN ACT CONCERNING THE USE OF PFAS IN CERTAIN PRODUCTS.

pfas_definition.provenance: Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances or "PFAS" means all members of the class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: On and after July 1, 2026, no person shall manufacture, sell, offer for sale or distribute for sale in this state any ... unless such product is labeled in accordance with this subsection.

products: outdoor apparel for severe wet conditions
exceptions: cosmetic product with unavoidable trace quantity of PFAS attributable to impurities of natural or synthetic ingredients
